title: Creamy Chicken Mexican Casserole
description: A rich and satisfying casserole filled with tender chicken, creamy sauce, and a blend of Mexican spices.
instructions: Cook the Mexican rice according to package instructions.
Dice the onions and bell peppers, and sauté in a pan until tender.
Add the cumin to the pan and stir to combine.
In a separate pan, warm the tortillas over medium heat.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked rice, sautéed onions and bell peppers, and cooked chicken.
In a separate bowl, combine the creamy salsa and shredded cheese.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of tortillas.
Next, add a layer of the rice and chicken mixture, followed by a layer of the creamy salsa and cheese mixture.
Repeat this process two more times, ending with a layer of the creamy salsa and cheese mixture on top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
